title: gentianella luridoviolacea
intro: Gentianella luridoviolacea, commonly known as Yellow Gentian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is known for its bright yellow flowers and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Gentianella luridoviolacea include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and the treatment of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
